title: Choose the visual world for Grocy Next
question: The roll assigned Seed Packet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Seed Packet
options.lineage: European vegetable seed packets: flat colour fronts, sowing calendars on the back
options.thesis: Every product, meal and chore reads like a packet back: bold name, then a calendar strip showing when it is good, due or gone.
materials: flat offset colour fields, one per domain
day-cell calendar strips with a today mark
options.viewport: Leaf-green rail; Stock opens on a green packet-front band, then rows of name, amount and a 28-day strip filled to the best-before day.
options.risk: Four domain colours can turn into a toy box; colour stays on bands, nav and strips, never on every row.

raised.raise: Length is exact time: every strip cell is one day on one scale shared by all rows.
Fixed furniture: name, amount, strip, date and action always sit in the same slots.
Flat unmodulated colour owns whole regions: each screen's band is a packet front, no gradients or tints of tints.
One 1px hairline weight for every rule; rows separate by rules, never by cards.
States are printed marks: bought items struck through, done chores filled, skipped ones hatched.

options.label: Shelf-Edge Ticket
options.lineage: supermarket shelf-edge price tickets and yellow offer labels
options.thesis: Every product is a shelf ticket: the amount huge, the name small, the date in the corner, readable from a metre away.
materials: yellow offer tickets for low and due
options.viewport: Black top bar; stock as a ruled list of tickets with oversized amounts; low and due items printed on yellow.
options.risk: Familiar retail look; too much yellow reads as a discount aisle.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.thesis: What is due next, as a departure board: rows ranked by time, columns that never move.
materials: amber row lamps for due soon
options.viewport: Black board of due stock and chores ranked by days left; amber for due soon, red for expired.
options.case: Fuses cleanly for time-ranked Stock and Chores; loses on audience, since a station is not the kitchen's world.
options.risk: A dark board fights bright shop light, and shopping lists are not time-ranked.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.thesis: Time flows upward; block length is exact duration.
options.viewport: Due items as a vertical score.
options.case: Fuses poorly: notation is foreign to a household audience.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.thesis: Products as a ranked mascot roster.
options.viewport: Pastel product grid with name plates.
options.risk: Playful to the point of slowing lookups.
options.case: Fuses poorly: mascots hide amounts and dates.

options.label: Zoo Guide Map
options.thesis: Each domain as a swelling lobe of flat colour.
options.viewport: Kitchen areas as a coloured map.
options.risk: Lobes eat the list space a phone needs.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a pantry is a list, not a territory.
options.kept: Flat colour that owns whole regions.

options.label: Design Annual Plates
options.thesis: Each screen as a registered plate on uncoated stock.
options.viewport: Stock as a quiet plate with crosshair corners.
options.risk: Too quiet; repeats the plainness being replaced.
options.case: Fuses poorly: editorial calm is the problem, not the fix.
options.kept: One hairline weight for every rule.

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference
options.thesis: Two columns around a rail of keys, apparatus in the margin.
options.viewport: Stock as a two-column reference page.
options.risk: Book setting on a phone in a shop.
options.case: Fuses poorly: scholarly apparatus slows a glance.
options.kept: States as printed marks: struck, filled, hatched.

canonCard.label: The category standard (Grocy-style)
canonCard.thesis: Grocy's own layout, executed impeccably: dark sidebar, dense tables, blue primary.
canonCard.viewport: Dark left sidebar, stock overview table with due badges, toolbar on top.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every self-hosted admin panel by design.
